text:
mira: quick heads-up — running AWQ-INT8 build of mistral-7b on our A100 pool with TensorRT-LLM runtime caused a measurable quality regression on the prompt eval suite. Perp jumped ~9%, avg Rouge-L down 3.5. Repro steps included below.

mira: env: CUDA=12.1, TRT-LLM rev=main@c13b, driver 535.54, AWQ quantizer v0.3. Commands: 
```
trtllm_server --model mistral-awq-int8.plan --cuda-version=12 --max-seqlen 2048
python run_eval.py --model trt://localhost:8080/mistral-awq --prompts eval/prompts.json --batch 8
```

mira: logs show many warnings like "unsupported dequant kernel, falling back to generic" and latency spikes around 40%.

jon: @mira can you paste a snippet of the warning? Also which quant config (symmetric/asymmetric, per-channel?)

mira: paste log: 
```
[trt-llm] WARN: AWQ kernel missing for INT8-perchannel -> using fp32 fallback
[trt-llm] WARN: kernel mismatch: compiled-for-cuda11 != runtime-cuda12
```

carla: that kernel mismatch is classic — TRT-LLM plan compiled with CUDA11 but you're running CUDA12 drivers. Did we run the planner on the build machine? 

mira: planner ran in CI image `nvidia/cuda:11.8-devel` (oops). Recompiled on CUDA12, but warning persists.

sam: Could be AWQ's packing layout changed; our trt plugins expect old quant layout. Try running with AWQ flag `--packing-layout=legacy` or regenerate the plan after quantizer update.

mira: tried legacy packing, reduced fallback warnings but quality still off ~2.5% worse than fp16 baseline.

perfbot: PERF: awq-int8/trtllm on A100: 1.9x token/sec vs fp16, latency p95 improved, but eval-quality delta: -2.5% rouge. Profile attached.

alex: do we have a diff between AWQ and GPTQ outputs for same prompts? Maybe AWQ calibration tables not applied.

mira: yes, I dumped final logits; AWQ logits are systematically less confident on stop tokens. Dump snippet:
```
idx 512: fp16: -0.12, awq-int8: -0.45
```

carla: plan: 1) open GH issue on trt-llm with logs + plan file, 2) rerun quantizer with new calibration set, 3) run vLLM path (cpu/gpu) to check whether problem is in quant or in trt runtime.

jon: I'll repro in my dev env (CUDA12 container) and try building TRT plugins from source. @mira share the plan and model files in /tmp.

mira: uploading to /tmp/mistral-awq-plan.tar.gz (link) — perms open to eng-ml. Also I've started a canary cluster with recompiled plan @ 1769991300.

deploybot: deploy started: canary/trtllm-mistral-awq -> eng-ml-canary-2 at 1769991325

mira: update — after rebuilding TRT plugins with CUDA12 toolchain, warnings gone and quality gap cut to -0.6%. Looks like a kernel codegen mismatch. Will keep running thorough evals overnight.

alex: great, if overnight runs look good, let's add a note to model onboarding checklist: "ensure TRT-LLM plan + plugins compiled against same CUDA minor version as runtime" :thumbsup: 

sam: and add a test to CI that runs the tiny eval suite under both trtllm and vllm to catch regressions early.

mira: agreed. will open PR for checklist + CI job. Thanks all.
